channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Daria and David are searching for a lakefront vacation home where they can unwind and teach dance; their first stop is a modern-rustic retreat with soaring ceilings, breathtaking lake views, a sleek gourmet kitchen, and a massive three-season room built for dancing; they tour a renovated home with an airy lofted great room, a gourmet kitchen with premium prep space, and a lower-level space for dancing; their final visit is a stunning showpiece with cathedral ceilings.
